snippet.title: The Butler - Official Gameplay Trailer | A New Psychological Indie Horror Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4168280/The_Butler/

A psychological horror spin-off of the acclaimed game Claire. You play as Deacon, a man searching for his missing father, but the deeper you dug, the darker the truths you uncovered, secrets you wish you’d never found, and that will haunt you forever.

From the creator of Ethel and Claire, The Butler delivers a deeply atmospheric, story filled with psychological tension, cinematic storytelling, and disturbing revelations.

Trailer Voiced By: @DeadeGuard98 

#horror #horrorgame #indiehorror #newhorrorgame #ethel #claire
